# Meta link-preview crawlers must be able to fetch shared invite links
# (/invite/CODE and legacy /?vip=CODE). Groups don't inherit from *, so this group restates the
# sensitive-path blocks but deliberately omits the query-param Disallows —
# those exist only to keep search engines from indexing duplicate URLs,
# which canonical tags already handle. Longest-match wins: /user/ stays
# blocked, everything else (including ?vip= links) is allowed.
User-agent: facebookexternalhit
User-agent: meta-externalagent
User-agent: Twitterbot
User-agent: TelegramBot
User-agent: Pinterestbot
User-agent: WhatsApp
User-agent: Viber
User-agent: ViberBot
Disallow: /user/
Disallow: /forgot-pwd
Disallow: /temporaryFreeze
Allow: /

User-agent: *
Disallow: /user/info
Disallow: /user/withdraw
Disallow: /user/linkBank
Disallow: /user/linkElewallet
Disallow: /user/transfer

Disallow: /user/overview

Disallow: /user/info/change-avatar

# Path-form invite links: one URL per invite code, endless near-duplicates of
